cohort: The study included 176 primigravida with term Premature Rupture of Membranes (PROM) from a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Prolonged PROM-to-delivery intervals were associated with increased maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was achieved in 53.41% of cases, while 46.59% underwent caesarean sections primarily due to fetal distress and failure to progress.
